headline_marked: Iran sends [[conditions for ending war]] to US via Qatar
headline: Iran sends conditions for ending war to US via Qatar
summary: Tehran demands the end of all hostilities, release of frozen assets, and lifting of naval blockades to return to the negotiating table.
details: Iran's top security official, Mohsen Rezaee, has sent formal conditions to Washington through Qatari mediation to end the ongoing conflict. The conditions include a total cessation of war on all fronts, the release of frozen Iranian funds, and the lifting of naval blockades.

Rezaee stated in an interview with Al Jazeera that Tehran is now awaiting a response from President Donald Trump. He emphasized that these terms are essential for Washington's own interests and warned that threats would not be effective.

The conflict began following the killing of Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei in a joint US-Israeli strike in late February. Since then, Qatar and Pakistan have been working to bring both nations back to diplomatic discussions after a previous memorandum of understanding expired.

Despite the diplomatic outreach, Rezaee warned that Iran is fully prepared for a 'final war' and has updated its military strategy. The new focus is on targeting US naval forces in the Persian Gulf, the Gulf of Oman, and the Arabian Sea.

Iran has recently conducted successful tests of ship-destroying missiles with multiple warheads near US warships. Rezaee warned that any future counter-attacks would be more intense, targeting not only military bases but also US commercial interests and companies in the region.

Analysts suggest that while Iran has dropped its demand for war reparations, Washington may not view these conditions as a sincere starting point for negotiations and could interpret them as a form of surrender.

headline_marked: 3 suspects detained as [[police recover iPhone from suspect's house]] in Cumilla teen murder
headline: 3 suspects detained as police recover iPhone from suspect's house in Cumilla teen murder
summary: The phone belonged to the mother of 13-year-old Ishiat Shahriar Opratim, whose body was found near Comilla University after he went missing for 24 hours.
details: 13-year-old Ishiat Shahriar Opratim, a Class VII student at Comilla Border Guard Public School, was found dead near Comilla University on Saturday afternoon.
Opratim had gone missing on Friday afternoon after leaving home to take photographs with his mother's iPhone.
Police have since recovered the iPhone from the house of a suspect named Tuhin, who is among three young men aged 18 to 20 detained in connection with the killing.
The victim was the only son of Nahida Begum, an associate professor of Bangla at Comilla University, and businessman KM Firoz Shahriar.
Police are currently analyzing CCTV footage and questioning the suspects to uncover the full details of the murder.
Cumilla Superintendent of Police Anisuzzaman is expected to brief the media on the investigation's progress today.
The boy's family is devastated, with his mother describing the heartbreaking loss of her only child.
caption:
A 13-year-old boy was found dead near Comilla University after disappearing for 24 hours. Police have now recovered his mother's iPhone from a suspect's house.

13-year-old Ishiat Shahriar Opratim, a Class VII student at Comilla Border Guard Public School, was found dead near Comilla University on Saturday afternoon.

Opratim had gone missing on Friday afternoon after leaving home to take photographs with his mother's iPhone.

Police have since recovered the iPhone from the house of a suspect named Tuhin, who is among three young men aged 18 to 20 detained in connection with the killing.

The victim was the only son of Nahida Begum, an associate professor of Bangla at Comilla University, and businessman KM Firoz Shahriar.

Police are currently analyzing CCTV footage and questioning the suspects to uncover the full details of the murder.

Cumilla Superintendent of Police Anisuzzaman is expected to brief the media on the investigation's progress today.

The boy's family is devastated, with his mother describing the heartbreaking loss of her only child.

#Cumilla #JusticeForOpratim #Bangladesh #CrimeNews #Justice

Source: The Daily Star, Dhaka Tribune, Prothom Alo, Jamuna TV
